name: io.geolocale/geolocale
title: GeoLocale
description: What is around a neighborhood: counts of everyday places within 1 km, from OpenStreetMap.

tools.name: find_cities
tools.description: List the cities GeoLocale covers, filtered by part of a city name and/or a country. Returns each city's id, its number of neighborhoods, how many have counts, the date of its map data and the address of its page.

query.description: Part of a city name, for example "lisbon".

country.description: Part of a country name in English, for example "portugal".

limit.description: How many cities to return. Default 25.

tools.name: compare_neighborhoods
tools.description: Set the neighborhoods of one city side by side: the distance to the nearest rail or metro station, and how many parks, supermarkets, pharmacies, schools, restaurants and cafes lie within 1 km of each neighborhood centre. Counted from OpenStreetMap; the answer carries the date of the map data.

city.description: City name, "name, country" when the name is shared, or GeoLocale's id for the city, for example "lisbon".

sort_by.description: Order by one measure: transit is closest station first, the others are most first. Omit for the order of the city page.

limit.description: How many neighborhoods to return. Default 30.

tools.name: neighborhood_facts
tools.description: Everything GeoLocale counted around one neighborhood: for each kind of place, the number within 1 km of the centre and the name and distance of the nearest one, plus the similar neighborhoods in other cities matched on the same counts. Counted from OpenStreetMap; the answer carries the date of the map data.

city.description: City name, "name, country", or GeoLocale's id for the city, for example "lisbon".

neighborhood.description: Neighborhood name as GeoLocale lists it on the city's page.
